# Blood

![Blood](https://scholzdev.github.io/tossup/img/coins/blood.png)

Big points, but Tails raises the quota.

- **Rarity:** Uncommon
- **Heads chance:** 60%
- **Shop price:** 22 gold
- **Energy to flip:** 1

## Heads
Score 11 points

## Tails
Quota +6

## Who can use it
- **Starts in the deck of:** none
- **Usable in coin sets from the start:** none
- **Found in the shop and unlocked by buying it once:** [The Blade](characters-blade), [The Seer](characters-seer)
